entries.text: Emit FACTORY_BUILD_JSON as the final act of the build stage even when the build is partial or failed, so downstream stages always receive steps/notes instead of a null record.
Have the verify stage hard-fail fast with a captured reason when the build record is absent, rather than propagating an all-null cycle to retro.
Park any pre-existing StarterPack tool into ServerStorage before installing a new weapon so the playtest equips the item under test and the prior rung stays restorable.

After a grip/animation preview lab, explicitly tear down the edit-time weld and re-set Tool.Grip to the final numbers before moving the Tool to StarterPack - a leftover preview weld or lab grip silently ships otherwise.

Roof WedgeParts and angled slabs have easy-to-invert rotation signs (producing a V-valley instead of a pitch) - capture the silhouette from front/iso immediately after placing roof geometry and before any detailing, since the error is invisible in numbers but obvious in one image.

Form real door/window openings by segmenting walls into separate parts around the gap (not by overlaying frames on solid walls) - it makes the building walk-through capable and lets frames/muntins read as depth on capture.

Judge animation filmstrips ONLY by what is visible in the frames: state which way the blade/item points relative to the fist and name one unpredicted detail; a strip where the item is not clearly visible is UNREADABLE and must be re-shot, never passed.
A backlit rig renders as an unjudgeable black silhouette: capture rigs/items with neutralLight=true (capture_animation does this automatically) and re-shoot rather than judge dark frames.
